note: Real-time layer plans, one per 15 minutes (start_time), each covering the next 96 slots: load_kw includes shiftable devices at their planned start; batt_kw positive = charging; soc_pct at the end of each slot; pv_kw is the 48-hour PV forecast published at 23:45 the night before (slots after midnight use the same forecast, not one published later). devices = [start, end) slot ranges relative to the plan's first slot.
